text: Upgrade cozo from 0.7 to 0.8+ and remove fd-lock workaround in connect_db once upstream SQLITE_BUSY unwrap panic is fixed (U015-FLK1). DEFERRED: cozo 0.8 does not yet exist on crates.io (latest stable: 0.7.6 as of 2026-05-01). Monitor upstream. See deliberation: docs/decisions/2026-05-01-cozodb-concurrency-hardening-deliberation.md

Fix integration_graph_vector_rehydration::daemon_rehydrates_graph_and_vector_state_after_db_directory_is_deleted — test times out at 30s waiting for startup auto-index to reach funcs >= 2. Pre-existing failure unrelated to U015-FLK1 (confirmed on clean main before 037-F). Investigate startup-index timing in the daemon and increase timeout or fix the root cause.

Fix integration_query_perf_observability (3 tests) — timing-stat buckets not populated during test runs. Pre-existing failure unrelated to U015-FLK1 (confirmed on clean main before 037-F). Investigate why stat buckets remain empty in test context (no warm-up, timer resolution, or missing instrumentation path).

Add SQLITE_BUSY retry logic to index_workspace handler (U015-FLK1): The s_cs4 concurrent indexing test is marked #[ignore] because index_workspace operations can collide on SQLITE_BUSY when two workspaces run concurrently. The fd-lock in connect_db covers the open/bootstrap phase but not write transactions after the DB is open. Add a retry loop (up to N attempts, exponential back-off) in the index_workspace handler around CozoDB write batches.

Fix flush_state to write nodes.jsonl to .engram/code-graph/main/ (026-F gap): The graph_vector_rehydration_test is marked #[ignore] because after flush_state+restart, nodes.jsonl is not written so graph rehydration produces an empty graph. flush_state / dehydrate_workspace() must write all code graph node files (nodes.jsonl, functions.jsonl, etc.) to .engram/code-graph/{branch_safe}/ so the daemon can fully rehydrate from disk.
